entities.summary: Jason Moses Estrada is an American former professional boxer who competed from 2004 to 2015. As an amateur, he competed at the 2004 Olympic Games in the super heavyweight division. He also won the gold medal at the 2003 Pan American Games. He is currently retired and owns and runs BigSix Boxing Academy located in Providence RI.
